other_conditions: AICTE approved Technical Institutions/University Departments with relevant PG programmes are eligible
Full‑time regular faculty with research experience and publications must be involved
Preliminary research facilities must be available in the institute
Only one proposal per Principal Investigator can be sanctioned at any point in time

Maximum of five proposals (including pending ones) may be submitted per institute, with a limit of three from government institutes and three from private institutes, and only two proposals can be approved simultaneously for each institute
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹25,00,000 funding for research projects over three years, with 75% non‑recurring and 25% recurring grant disbursement.
documents_required: Verified Bank Mandate Form (PDF, max 10 MB)
